title: 第5章 大获全胜原来我的丹药这么牛逼第6章 完了人设彻底崩了
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
冷月涵根本没有在意台下的争论。
她不愧是修行天才！
召唤出来短短的片刻时间，她赫然发现，自己和这头金刚之间，竟有一道若有若无的神识联系！
这个发现，让她心头狂跳。
她试探性地将一缕神识探了过去，小心翼翼地触碰到了大猩猩的意识核心。
嗡！
下一刻，一个奇妙无比的感觉涌上心头。
她感觉自己仿佛凭空多出了第二个身体！
一个充满了爆炸性力量、气血磅礴的强大肉身！
冷月涵下意识地抬起了自己的右手。
擂台的另一边，那头巨大的黑猩猩，也同步地抬起了它那砂锅大的右拳！
她微微侧身。
大猩猩也跟着侧身，动作分毫不差，宛如镜中倒影！
“这……这不就是……”
冷月涵的呼吸都变得急促起来。
这不就跟她在太虚幻境里操纵自己的游戏角色一样吗？
不！
比那更高级，更刺激！
太虚幻境里的一切都是虚假的，虽然通过幻境，做到了对现实的完美模拟……
可眼前这具身体，却是活生生的、实打实的、练气大圆满的强悍肉身！

再完美的模拟，怎么可能比的过真实？
网瘾少女的灵魂，在这一刻被彻底点燃！
“原来是这样玩的！”
冷·游戏高手·月涵，嘴角勾起一抹不易察察觉的弧度。
只见她不再迟疑，深吸一口气，气沉丹田，摆出了青云宗最基础的拳法起手式。
面前的金刚，也轰的一声，双脚踏地，摆出了一个威势惊人、但姿势一模一样的起手式！
这一幕，彻底引爆了全场！
台下的观众们，全都激动起来了。
“快看，大师姐在操控那只妖兽！”
“这是怎么做到的？”
有御兽峰的弟子不可思议：“完全没有御兽的痕迹，这不是御兽术！”
“奇哉！怪哉！”
就在此时。
观礼台上，一位御兽峰的长老忽然抚掌大笑，激动地站了起来：“妙哉！妙哉啊！”
他指着擂台，高声为众人解惑：“李玄此子，当真是丹道鬼才！”
“他这丹药，不是简单的召唤出一头炼气大圆满的妖兽！”
“甚至，将如何控制这头妖兽，都已经安排好了！”
content_en:
Leng Yuehan didn't pay attention to the debate in the audience at all.
She is indeed a spiritual genius!
In just a few moments after summoning it, she suddenly discovered that there was a vague spiritual connection between herself and this King Kong!
This discovery made her heart beat wildly.
She tentatively probed a ray of consciousness and carefully touched the core of the gorilla's consciousness.
Buzz!
The next moment, a wonderful feeling came to my mind.
She felt as if she had a second body out of thin air!
A powerful body full of explosive power and majestic blood!
Leng Yuehan subconsciously raised her right hand.
On the other side of the ring, the huge chimpanzee also raised its right fist as big as a casserole in synchronization!
She turned slightly.
The gorilla also turned sideways, and his movements were exactly like a reflection in a mirror!
"This...isn't this just..."
Leng Yuehan's breathing became rapid.
Isn't this just like her controlling her own game character in a fantasy world?
No!
It's more advanced and exciting than that!
Everything in the Taixu illusion is false, although through the illusion, a perfect simulation of reality is achieved...
But the body in front of me is a living, solid, powerful physical body that has perfected the Qi practice!
No matter how perfect the simulation is, how can it possibly compare to reality?
The soul of the Internet-addicted girl was completely ignited at this moment!
"So that's how it works!"
Leng·Game Master·Yuehan, the corner of his mouth raised an arc that was difficult to detect.
She no longer hesitated, took a deep breath, let her energy sink into her Dantian, and assumed the most basic starting position of the Qingyun Sect's boxing techniques.
The King Kong in front of him also made a bang, stepped on the ground with both feet, and made an amazingly powerful but exactly the same starting posture!
This scene completely detonated the whole audience!
The audience in the audience were all excited.
"Look, Senior Sister is controlling that monster!"
"How is this done?"
A disciple from the Beast Control Peak was in disbelief: "There is no trace of beast control at all. This is not a beast control technique!"
"How strange! How strange!"
Right now.
On the viewing platform, an elder from Yushou Peak suddenly put his hands on his hands and laughed, standing up excitedly: "Wonderful! How wonderful!"
He pointed to the ring and loudly answered everyone's questions: "Li Xuan is really a genius in alchemy!"
"His elixir does not simply summon a demonic beast with perfect Qi refining!"
"We have even made arrangements on how to control this monster!"
